sources.name: SEC Fails-to-Deliver (NSCC CNS aggregate equity fails), served half-month archive

archived_page_evidence.note: sha re-computed by this audit and matches the sha pinned in sec_ftd_manifest.json exactly

semantics.event_time: SETTLEMENT DATE column (YYYYMMDD) = date as of which the fails balance is outstanding. Page text (measured in archived HTML): 'The values of total fails-to-deliver shares represent the aggregate net balance of shares that failed to be delivered as of a particular settlement date'; 'a cumulative number of all fails outstanding until that day, plus new fails that occur that day, less fails that settle that day'. It is a per-settlement-date STOCK (net balance), not a daily flow; age of fails is not determinable from it.
semantics.effective_time: Same as event_time for the fails quantity (CNS end-of-day aggregate balance as of the settlement date). PRICE column is prior-day close per page text: 'The price field includes the closing price of the security on the previous day' ('.' when unavailable or < 1 cent) - so PRICE trails the settlement date by one trading day.
semantics.available_time: NOT machine-served per file. Page-stated posting cadence (exact quote from archived page): 'Starting July 2009, each month is contained in two files. The first half of a given month is available at the end of the month. The second half of a given month is available at about the 15th of the next month. We cannot guarantee that the data will be posted by a particular date.' => earliest-plausible posting is ~15-16 calendar days after the covered settlement half-month ends, with no guaranteed posting date. Per-file exact posting timestamps: NOT_MEASURED (HTTP header probes this audit returned SEC fair-access 403, see audit_probes).
semantics.retrieved_time: Per-file retrieved_time_utc pinned in sec_ftd_archive_manifest.json (e.g. samples 2026-09-16T08:49:10Z/12Z); local archive = as-published bytes at retrieval; two_pull_equality verdict IDENTICAL for cnsfails202004b.zip (sha256 0c76d404fbd48726c22ea031092ec208fbf42fb41ca4128adaccfa493d6259e7 both pulls).

raw_bytes_measurements_this_audit.archive_inventory: 434/434 zips local in /Users/hoangminhlong/.my-quantitative-data/free-data-frontier-v1/raw/sec_ftd_archive/ matching the page listing exactly. Composition measured from the page's own zip listing JSON: 410 half-month files cnsfails{YYYYMM}{a,b}.zip spanning 200907..202608 (206 months), 22 quarterly files cnsp_sec_fails_{YYYY}q{N}.zip spanning 2004q1..2009q2, and 2 repost variants (cnsfails202308b_0.zip, cnsfails201910a_0.zip). The verdict's '434 full served archive 2009-07..2026-08' reconciles as: half-month series starts 2009-07; earlier coverage is the 22 quarterly FOIA-document files.
raw_bytes_measurements_this_audit.column_schema: 6 pipe-delimited columns, IDENTICAL across all 6 files opened spanning 2009, 2019, 2020, 2026 and the quarterly zip: SETTLEMENT DATE | CUSIP | SYMBOL | QUANTITY (FAILS) | DESCRIPTION | PRICE. Files end with a non-data trailer row 'Trailer total quantity of shares N' (must be excluded by parsers; N reconciles to the sum of the quantity column only if de-duplicated at CUSIP-settlement level - parser guard required).

row_counts_measured.cnsp_sec_fails_2009q2.zip: 136589 data rows across 3 monthly members (cnsp_sec_fails_200904/200905/200906.txt); same 6-column schema

raw_bytes_measurements_this_audit.filename_encodes_settlement_half_month_c: MEASURED TRUE. Settlement-date min/max per file: cnsfails202607a = 20260701..20260714; cnsfails202607b = 20260715..20260731; cnsfails202608a = 20260803..20260814; cnsfails202608b = 20260817..20260831 (gaps = weekends/holidays). 'a' = first settlement half-month, 'b' = second.
raw_bytes_measurements_this_audit.cross_file_overlap_test: MEASURED ZERO: all 6 pairwise intersections of settlement-date sets across cnsfails202607a/b and cnsfails202608a/b are empty. Later files do NOT re-include earlier settlement dates - the half-month files partition the settlement calendar with no date-level restatement channel inside one archive vintage.

revisions_handling.within_archive_vintage: MEASURED: settlement dates partition exactly across consecutive half-month files (zero overlap, 6 files sampled Jul-Aug 2026); no in-vintage restatement of earlier settlement weeks observed.
revisions_handling.across_vintages: NOT_MEASURED: row-level quantity restatement between an original posting and any later re-download requires a second vintage; this audit holds one vintage only. Page disclaims accuracy twice ('We cannot guarantee the accuracy of the data'), and the page itself lists 2 '_0'-suffix repost variants - corrections do occur as reposted zip objects. Mitigation: the local archive pins exact-URL identity and sha256 per file; a future vintage can be diffed file-by-file against the pinned hashes.
revisions_handling.quarterly_to_monthly_series_splice: 2004q1..2009q2 quarterly files (monthly members inside) share the identical 6-column schema; pre-2008-09-16 rows include only balances >= 10,000 shares (page text) - threshold change must be flagged in any series splice.

sources.coverage_bound: Half-month series 2009-07..2026-08 complete (410 files); quarterly series 2004q1..2009q2 (22 files, <=10k-share threshold before 2008-09-16); equities only; NSCC CNS aggregate over all members; page explicitly: fails 'are not necessarily the result of short selling, and are not evidence of abusive short selling or naked short selling'.

sources.evidence_class_qualifier: PIT ruling holds UNDER THE CONSERVATIVE RULE ONLY. The publication BOUND is evidenced by the sha-pinned official page cadence text; per-file exact posting timestamps are NOT_MEASURED (HTTP probes blocked). Any use that assumes availability earlier than the bound is RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY by definition.

d2_usability_ruling.permitted: State-conditioning control use: at decision time t, a file is usable only if posting_bound(file) <= t, where posting_bound = (settlement half-month end date + 15 calendar days) as the measured earliest-plausible posting; recommend a >=16-day conditioning guard (+1 day over the bound, because the page guarantees no posting date). Use as a settlement-stress LEVEL (net balance) control only; CUSIP-level joins require a CUSIP-history guard (CUSIPs are re-used over decades).
d2_usability_ruling.forbidden: (1) treating SETTLEMENT DATE as availability; (2) any short-selling/manipulation attribution (page-explicit interpretation guard); (3) historical scored joins on the 2009-2026 archive without labeling them RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY until a per-file publication-timestamp evidence pass runs (successor pass: capture posting dates, e.g. via EDGAR-full-text-free periodic snapshots of the page listing); (4) splicing the pre-2008-09-16 quarterly rows without the 10k-share-threshold flag.

sources.name: SEC Form N-PORT (DERA quarterly data sets), 2026q2 single-quarter sample

semantics.event_time: REPORT_DATE = 'Date as of which information is reported' (nport_readme.htm A.3.b; readme sha-pinned inside 2026q2_nport.zip, member listing quarterly_2026q2_nport_members.json). Measured distinct REPORT_DATEs in SUBMISSION.tsv are month-ends (e.g. 28-FEB-2026, 31-MAR-2026) plus fiscal year-ends - the monthly NPORT-P reporting regime. Holdings are portfolio positions as of the report period end.
semantics.effective_time: Same as event_time for holdings (positions as of report period end). No intramonth effective dating exists in the dataset.
semantics.available_time: Two documented bounds, both day-granularity: (1) SUBMISSION.tsv FILING_DATE = EDGAR filing DATE only ('Filing date DATE', readme) - no acceptance time in the DERA set; measured filing lag FILING_DATE - REPORT_DATE: min 12d, p50 57d, p95 62d, max 1225d, 92.1% within 60d (n=14,416). (2) Dataset inclusion rule quoted from nport_readme.htm: 'Data contained in documents filed after 5:30pm EST on the last business day of the quarter will be included in the next quarterly posting.' Per-zip posting timestamp: NOT machine-served. Strict available_time stays NULL (frozen manifests); conservative D2 rule: available_time = FILING_DATE end-of-day + 1 day guard, or the quarterly-posting bound, never REPORT_DATE.
semantics.retrieved_time: 2026q2 zip retrieved 2026-09-16T09:18:23Z, sha256 077cc836a978a593b29012219395fbe9c303d5e930f5be3b5f4353c3b02296fc (440,699,889 bytes, 32 members, 1.55 GiB uncompressed listing). Two-pull equality NOT_APPLIED_LARGE (440 MB object; recorded in verdict not_run).

amendments_handling.flag: SUB_TYPE distinguishes original NPORT-P from amendment NPORT-P/A (352 measured this quarter). Same-registrant+period resubmissions appear as distinct ACCESSION_NUMBERs - accession is the immutable filing identity.
amendments_handling.supersession_rule: IS_LAST_FILING is NOT a revision flag: readme defines it as 'Does the Fund anticipate that this will be its final filing on Form N-PORT' (A.4) - i.e., wind-down anticipation. Latest-vintage resolution must be computed as: per (SERIES_ID/CIK, REPORT_DATE), keep max(FILING_DATE) accession; never blindly overwrite.
amendments_handling.not_in_dataset: EDGAR acceptance datetime (intraday) is not in the DERA set; obtaining it requires per-accession EDGAR index fetches - NOT acquired this cycle (intraday acceptance NOT_MEASURED).

sources.coverage_bound: ONE quarter (2026q2) - the V1 acquisition cap. Therefore any long-history crowding/ownership claim is INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE by construction. Measured absences: SPY absent from 2026q2 FUND_REPORTED_INFO by exact SERIES_NAME; GLD structurally out of N-PORT scope (non-1940-Act commodity trust). Current-quarter holdings must NEVER be used to reconstruct historical holdings - each filing covers a single report period; history requires back-acquisition of earlier quarterly datasets (not acquired).

sources.evidence_class_qualifier: Day-granularity availability only (FILING_DATE + documented 5:30pm-EST quarterly cutoff); intraday acceptance NOT_MEASURED; coverage cap makes long-history claims INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE regardless of PIT class.

d2_usability_ruling.permitted: Prospective state-conditioning with available_time = FILING_DATE + 1 day guard (p50 lag 57d, p95 62d - so any conditioning window must be >= ~63 days after report period end; 60 days is NOT a safe bound, p95 exceeds it). Within-2026q2 cross-sectional controls (e.g. current crowding proxy) are permitted as a snapshot; amendment-safe joins must apply the supersession rule (max FILING_DATE per series+REPORT_DATE).
d2_usability_ruling.forbidden: (1) long-history crowding/ownership panels - INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE (one quarter); (2) reconstructing historical holdings from the current snapshot; (3) real-time positioning inference (never faster than the measured ~57-62d filing lag); (4) assuming SPY/GLD coverage (measured absent); (5) using IS_LAST_FILING as a revision flag.

headline_rulings.ftd: PIT_EVIDENCED under the conservative rule only: available_time = file posting bound = settlement-half-month end + 15 days measured earliest-plausible (page cadence 'first half at end of month, second half about the 15th of next month, no guaranteed posting date'); recommend >=16-day conditioning guard; settlement date is NEVER availability; historical scored joins on the 2009-07..2026-08 archive stay RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY until a per-file publication-timestamp evidence pass; settlement dates partition exactly across half-month files (zero overlap measured) - no in-vintage restatement channel.
headline_rulings.nport: PIT_EVIDENCED at day granularity: available_time = FILING_DATE (+1 day guard), never REPORT_DATE; measured lag p50 57d / p95 62d (60 days is not a safe bound); amendments flagged by SUB_TYPE=NPORT-P/A (352/14,416) with supersession = max FILING_DATE per (series, REPORT_DATE); IS_LAST_FILING is a final-filing flag, not a revision flag; one-quarter coverage cap -> any long-history crowding claim INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE; current holdings never reconstruct historical holdings.
